summary.text: Bill Ridenour (listed by Ballotpedia as William Ridenour) is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates who has represented District 100 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired U.S. Marine Corps officer and defense intelligence officer, he describes himself as a constitutional conservative.

paragraphs.text: Bill Ridenour was born in Springfield, Ohio, and served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1980 to 2000.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Purdue University in 1980, a graduate degree from the University of Oklahoma in 2000 and a graduate degree from the Marine Corps War College in 2017.
His professional experience includes working as a defense intelligence officer in the Defense Intelligence Agency and as chief of strategic policy with the Pentagon.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Ridenour said he retired in 2021 as the Joint Staff J2 Chief of Strategic Policy and described himself as a constitutional conservative.

He said he supports reducing the size of federal and state government, cutting taxes, legal immigration and a Convention of States to amend the Constitution to require a balanced federal budget and limit federal power.
